name: Financial Data Book
query:
SELECT 
    s.custom_student_code AS "كود الطالب:Link/Student:120",
    s.student_name AS "الطالب:Data:200",
    s.custom_status AS "الحالة::100",
    s.custom_previous_balance AS "الماضي:Float:100",
    s.custom_current_period_fee AS "اشتراك الفترة:Float:120",
    '' AS "شهر 1::80",
    '' AS "شهر 2::80",
    '' AS "شهر 3::80",
    IFNULL(sg.student_group_name, '') AS "المجموعة::150",
    IFNULL(sg.custom_main_instructor, '') AS "المعلم/ة::150",
    '' AS "ملاحظات::200",
    (SELECT value FROM `tabSingles` WHERE doctype='Quran Settings' AND field='current_period') AS current_period
FROM 
    `tabStudent` s
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabStudent Group` sg ON s.custom_student_group = sg.name
WHERE 
    (%(custom_branch)s IS NULL OR %(custom_branch)s = '' OR s.custom_branch = %(custom_branch)s)
ORDER BY 
    s.student_name ASC
